newsitem.title: GABON: Zaire's Mobutu, Kabila agree to meet on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Mobutu, Kabila agree to meet on Wednesday.

text.p: Zaire's President Mobutu Sese Seko and rebel leader Laurent Kabila have agreed to meet on Wednesday, South African Deputy President Thabo Mbeki said after meeting Mobutu in Gabon on Saturday.
"Both of them have agreed to meet on Wednesday on the boat," Mbeki told reporters after the meeting in the Gabonese capital Libreville.
Face-to-face talks between the two civil war foes, hosted on board a South African ship off Congo by South Africa's Nelson Mandela, ended inconclusively last weekend.
Mbeki said Wednesday's talks would make clear Mobutu's role and all substantive questions would be discussed.
